review.evidence: The 2024 French cohort explicitly names sodium bicarbonate (reported as E500): premenopausal breast-cancer subgroup HR 1.48 (95% CI 1.07–2.05). This is not a general-population result or a causal experiment.
review.conditions: The existing limited-precaution tier screens the reported subgroup signal; it does not assume the user belongs to that subgroup. No intake, exposure or individual risk is inferred. Generic E500 and other carbonates do not acquire this finding.
review.conflicts: Subgroup analyses, multiple testing, confounding and intake measurement limit inference; independent replication is needed. FDA-hosted SCOGS report 26 (1975) records a no-hazard-concern conclusion for then-current/expected uses. That historical assessment is not a review of the 2024 signal.
